subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**' i.e. '**digital**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank needs an adjective to describe the noun '**Kids**'.
 
• The term **'born digital'** is an established phrase that accurately represents children who grow up with digital technology as an inherent part of their lives.
 
• **'Digital'** as an adjective fits grammatically and contextually to describe the kind of kids Tim Cook is referring to.
 
• Using **'digital'** maintains the coherence of the passage, making it clear and concise.

Therefore, the correct answer is-** digital**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Digitally:** This is an adverb and does not fit grammatically as it cannot directly describe the noun 'Kids'.
 
• **Digitalise: **This is a verb and does not fit the context as the sentence requires an adjective.
 
• **Digitalised: **This is the past participle form of the verb 'digitalise' and does not fit as it is not an adjective describing 'Kids'.
